guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins extended trades once Counter Strike is down; Jax wins if he baits Riposte and lands the stun first.

keyTips.text: Take Q vital trades only while Counter Strike is unavailable, then leave at once. Extending into his ready stun flips a winning trade into his.
keyTips.heading: Trading rule

keyTips.text: Hold Riposte for his leap or empowered strike, not his stun by default. Parrying mid-leap and angling it sideways stuns him as he lands and opens the fight after his E ends.
keyTips.heading: Riposte discipline

keyTips.text: Never be the first to commit to a full fight when both cooldowns are up. The first engager usually loses this matchup, so force his Counter Strike or leap before committing yours.
keyTips.heading: Engagement rule

tips.text: Hide the start of your Q by feinting in and out of range or last-hitting. Obvious Q approaches are easy for him to answer with a timed Counter Strike.
tips.heading: Concealing Q

tips.text: Match his Ignite if he takes it, or expect a much harder lane. Without your own Ignite you cannot answer his committed all-ins at low health.
tips.heading: Summoner check

tips.text: After his Counter Strike ends, that is your window to fight. Trade into the cooldown gap rather than testing Riposte against an unreadable stun timing.
tips.heading: Post-stun window

tips.text: Crash waves and keep pressure so he cannot reset bad vitals for free. He gives up unfavorable vital positions through vision plays, so deny him the quiet resets.
tips.heading: Vital control

tips.text: Take even fights and punish wasted Counter Strikes. When his stun misses or hits only the wave, he has no answer left for your full rotation.
tips.heading: Punish wasted E

tips.text: If he leaps onto someone else while using Counter Strike, Q into him and start your ult from that less predictable angle. His engage on a teammate is your cleanest R setup of the fight.
tips.heading: Teamfight entry

sources.author: PH45
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; no title claim) · Jax main

guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins by poking at max range and running down duels; Garen wins if he baits Riposte and lands silence into ult.

keyTips.text: Poke with max-range Q to a vital and leave at once. Q into melee range lets him answer with his spin, while max-range procs deal damage he cannot return.
keyTips.heading: Poke rule

keyTips.text: Bait out his spin before taking a longer trade. Committing into a held E wastes your health, so make him spend it on nothing first.
keyTips.heading: E bait

keyTips.text: Hold Riposte for his silence or ult, never spend it early. He fakes Q to draw your W, so answer only the committed Q or the ult itself.
keyTips.heading: W discipline

tips.text: Use the vital's movement speed to exit his spin. Tanking the full spin makes the matchup far worse, so proc and leave the moment he commits.
tips.heading: Spin exits

tips.text: Expect him to cancel his spin early into a surprise Q. Do not overcommit on a shortened E, since the silence follow-up is the real threat.
tips.heading: E-cancel watch

tips.text: With Conqueror and high health, run him down the lane. Your dueling at full health beats his, so keep the lane long and press the health advantage.
tips.heading: Run-down rule

tips.text: Take vitals on the open side when he walls off the marked angle. His wall positioning denies one side, so circle to the angle he cannot cover.
tips.heading: Wall answer

tips.text: Maintain pressure instead of yielding, from early through outscale. You are ahead at every point of the lane, so conceding waves gives him the one thing he needs: time.
tips.heading: Pressure rule

tips.text: Chase his split with your threat, but never into his team. Your split-push runs him down solo, while his numbers answer is the only thing that stops it.
tips.heading: Split threat

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Challenger EUNE / Grandmaster EUW (self-claim, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins by conceding levels 1–2, parrying W, and taking the side-lane 1v1; Darius wins if he lands an early all-in, holds Ghost for long kites, or reaches a five-stack reset.

keyTips.text: Concede levels 1–2 entirely, then open trading at 3. His level-1 all-in beats yours, so max-range Q pokes are the whole early plan until your kit comes online.
keyTips.heading: Level-3 rule

keyTips.text: Parry his W rather than his E. The W read lands more consistently, and his held E exists to bait the greedy Riposte.
keyTips.heading: W over E

keyTips.text: Never start a long trade into a held Ghost without a cooldown opening. A skilled Darius holds E and W for exactly that kite, so force shorts until the summoner is spent.
keyTips.heading: Ghost respect

tips.text: Touch him at level 1 only with max-range Q. Anything closer feeds the one all-in you lose, so poke the vital and leave.
tips.heading: Level-1 poke

tips.text: Never throw Q at his spacing. He gives no vitals for free and answers committed dashes with W plus Q, so enter on his whiff, not on your cooldown.
tips.heading: No dry Qs

tips.text: Enter only after he spends Stridebreaker on the wave. The active guarantees his Q edge if you dash in blind, so let it resolve on minions first.
tips.heading: Stridebreaker window

tips.text: Start Blade Waltz only with his back to open ground. A walled back denies a vital and kills both the proc and the healing zone.
tips.heading: R walls

tips.text: Take the side-lane 1v1 once the early concede ends. That duel is yours when you pick the timing instead of answering his.
tips.heading: Side take

tips.text: Never fight him at five stacks without a team edge, even from ahead. His reset chain swings the fight off a single R, so disengage the stacked state.
tips.heading: Reset fear

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Challenger EUNE / Grandmaster EUW (self-claim, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins by answering shield trades with Riposte and punishing Hookshot; Camille wins if she baits W and lands undisturbed second Qs.

keyTips.text: Never stand in the outer ring of her sweep. Dodge into the inner cone or Q completely out, since the outer hit sets up the trade you cannot win.
keyTips.heading: Sweep positioning

keyTips.text: After her shield auto lands, Riposte the poke and Q away. Trading through her passive shield wastes damage, while the parry-plus-disengage turns her shield window into yours.
keyTips.heading: Shield answer

keyTips.text: If she does not misplay, wait for a clear Hookshot opening. Forcing into her terrain loses; patience for her E is the whole matchup.
keyTips.heading: Patience rule

tips.text: Fight in the middle of the lane, never near walls. Her Hookshot needs terrain, so open ground starves her engage while your vitals stay contestable.
tips.heading: Terrain rule

tips.text: Spend Q and W on offense, not on dodging every ability. The more you burn defensively, the harder the next fight gets, so take some poke to keep answers ready.
tips.heading: Cooldown economy

tips.text: Bait her Hookshot in the open, then Flash Q W toward the wall she grapples to. The wall-bait turns her engage angle into your stun setup.
tips.heading: Hookshot bait

tips.text: Save Riposte for her ult when a gank arrives. Blocking the lockdown lets you walk out of the dive instead of dying with W unused.
tips.heading: Gank answer

tips.text: Kite her second Q and sweep with vital and ult move speed. She needs the standing second proc, so never give her a stationary target once her Q1 lands.
tips.heading: Kiting Q2

tips.text: Vary your own Riposte timing since she varies Hookshot to bait it. She holds E waiting for your W, so show trades without parrying before spending it.
tips.heading: Riposte mindgame

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Challenger EUNE / Grandmaster EUW (self-claim, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins by timing Riposte on his Q casts after E and reaching the one-item turn; Aatrox wins if he controls the early waves and baits every parry with E.

keyTips.text: Answer his Q cast with Q into W. As he swings, dash in and parry: the block eats the damage and the stun converts his swing into your trade.
keyTips.heading: Q-W answer

keyTips.text: Wait out his E, then parry the follow-up. Everything before the dash is bait, so hold Riposte for the Q knock-up or W pull that comes after it.
keyTips.heading: Post-E parry

keyTips.text: Vary Riposte timing every trade. He refuses to dash into a held parry and hides his vitals, so a predictable W is one he plays around for free.
keyTips.heading: Unreadable W

tips.text: Let him hold the first waves. His sustain wins the opening, so farm without assuming you dictate and save challenges for windows he gives you.
tips.heading: Concede the open

tips.text: Re-angle when he walls off a vital. He pre-positions because he fears the proc, so Q to a new mark instead of tunneling a denied one.
tips.heading: Denied vitals

tips.text: Leave chains with Q or movement speed and save W for damage. Spending the parry as an exit is exactly what his E-bait wants from you.
tips.heading: Exits without W

tips.text: Never fire W at a non-damaging effect by habit. Each wasted parry makes the rest of the lane harder, so keep it holstered until a real cast starts.
tips.heading: Parry discipline

tips.text: Parry his W pull only when the landing spot continues your fight. Refusing a bad pull denies his setup without spending your answer for nothing.
tips.heading: Pull position

tips.text: Play for the item turn. At even gold your outscale arrives around one item, and from behind it waits until two, so force nothing before the spike lands.
tips.heading: Item timing

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Challenger EUNE / Grandmaster EUW (self-claim, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins extended trades and the side-lane 1v1 by answering Q3 and R with Riposte; Yone wins if he kites vitals on E movement or punishes chases at the spirit return.

keyTips.text: Parry his Q3 or R on commitment. When Yone dashes in on the third cast or fires his ultimate, answer with Riposte: the stun turns his engage into your trade.
keyTips.heading: Parry the commit

keyTips.text: Take extended trades. His answers are max-range Q pokes or kiting on E movement while you work vitals, so start fights where neither escape is free.
keyTips.heading: Extendeds favor you

keyTips.text: Never force a heavy trade while his E offers a free return. Make him spend E for distance first, since a held E lets him dictate every exchange.
keyTips.heading: Respect held E

tips.text: Trade back when he lands from E within reach. Take the free autos on his return instead of chasing into the escape window he just used.
tips.heading: E-return punish

tips.text: Match his first boots timing. He rushes boots to kite around your vitals, so complete yours on the same reset and his Q spacing never goes unanswered.
tips.heading: Boots race

tips.text: Keep Riposte ready while he holds R after Q3. His outplay line is R behind a severe Q, and your held stun inverts it the moment he commits.
tips.heading: R behind Q3

tips.text: Fire Riposte on his commit instead of holding it forever. He cannot cleanse the W stun with E, so waiting out the spirit form only wastes your best answer.
tips.heading: No cleanse

tips.text: Read his escape before chasing. If his spirit is pulling back or he holds Q3 as an exit, either one ends your chase, so stop and reset instead of following into his return.
tips.heading: Chase rule

tips.text: Take the side-lane 1v1. You are favored there once his two kite windows run out, so hold the side and let him come to you.
tips.heading: Side rule

tips.text: Start clean fights outside his kite windows. Never follow his E movement speed while he is still landing vitals; engage when the speed fades and the marks are yours.
tips.heading: Clean engages

sources.author: ZacheryZZTOP
sources.rankClaim: Grandmaster (lolmatchups account tier, Riot-linked ZacheryZZTOP#TOP) · Yone main

guides.favoredWhen: Fiora wins by refusing his Haymaker and fighting on her terms; Sett wins any full-grit extended trade he gets to start.

keyTips.text: Poke with max-range Q to a vital, then disengage before he answers. Giving him contact after the proc lets him stick with Q move speed and build the grit that wins him the trade.
keyTips.heading: Poke rule

keyTips.text: Save Riposte for his Haymaker, not his pull. His W is the fight decider, so bait Facebreaker at max range and keep W until the true-damage center matters.
keyTips.heading: Riposte discipline

keyTips.text: Leave before he builds grit or move the fight outside the minion wave. Fighting inside his stacked wave feeds his W while your vitals go unanswered.
keyTips.heading: Grit awareness

tips.text: Contest level 1 only with a first auto Q from a bush. That opener wins the all-in, but a face-to-face level 1 without it belongs to him.
tips.heading: Level 1

tips.text: If he uses Facebreaker early while he has no grit, take the heavier trade. With no W behind it his E is just an engage, and your saved Riposte answers the follow-up Haymaker.
tips.heading: Punishing early E

tips.text: After level 6, stand behind him so his ult carries him away from your turret. When he grabs you under tower, the displacement throws him into a bad spot instead of you.
tips.heading: Beating his ult

tips.text: Trigger your ult heal early enough to matter, or delay the proc until it executes him. Popping all four vitals without the heal timing just gives him a carried target.
tips.heading: Ult timing

tips.text: Aim fights toward a wall so his ult cannot carry you out of your healing. The wall shortens his displacement and keeps you inside the ult zone you already started.
tips.heading: Positioning

tips.text: Build early armor into his lane since the matchup stays volatile. Bramble and armor boots blunt his extended damage while your side-lane scaling takes over.
tips.heading: Item setup

keyTips.text: Run the aggressive setup of Press the Attack with Flash and Ignite for early duel pressure.
Spend Riposte as a damage trading tool too, blocking spikes like Riven R, Jax W, or Jayce Q when they threaten.
Split as the default win path and group only for clearly favorable teamfights.

tips.text: Treat most lanes as even or losing and hunt an outplay instead of assuming free wins.
Skip picking Fiora without confidence in her lane patterns.
Play for the two-item point, which usually passes the lane opponent; refuse risky early all-ins before it arrives.
After laning, take a standing top outer with Ravenous Hydra, spending R when an opponent contests.
Heal heavily with the Hydra active inside a wave, then take long trades while it sustains.
Once the outer falls, move to an inner-tower lane and keep banking gold and experience there.
Track who can stop the split, since opponents arriving before wave healing still win the trade.
Farm sides and press towers until gold and experience outscale most top laners.
Land R on a fighter to raise the healing zone for Fiora and nearby teammates.
Make sure R actually fires in teamfights; dying first likely loses the fight.
With Death's Dance and Plated Steelcaps, play front-to-back more safely while Riposte stays up.
Flash onto a squishy or low-health finisher when it converts, keeping W ready against burst.

itemization.text: Run Press the Attack with Triumph, Legend: Alacrity, and Last Stand, plus Biscuit Delivery and Jack of All Trades with two adaptive shards for stronger early trades.
Rush Ravenous Hydra first for waveclear, sustain, and taking the top turret.
Follow the example build of Trinity Force with Plated Steelcaps, Death's Dance, Spear of Shojin, and Endless Hunger.
Swap to Mercury's Treads and Maw of Malmortius against a strong AP threat, else keep Plated Steelcaps.
